tool.name: mOTUs_profiler
tool.description: profiles the abundance of microbial taxa
tool.command: @DATABASE_DIR_SETUP@ #if $input_type.input_type_selector == 'single': #set $reads = 'input_reads.' + $input_type.single_reads.ext ln -s '$input_type.single_reads' '$reads' && #else: #set $reads_fwd = 'input_reads_fwd.' + $input_type.forward_reads.ext #set $reads_rev = 'input_reads_rev.' + $input_type.reverse_reads.ext ln -s '$input_type.forward_reads' '$reads_fwd' && ln -s '$input_type.reverse_reads' '$reads_rev' && #end if motus profile -db '$DATABASE_DIR' -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -n '$sample_name' #if $input_type.input_type_selector == 'single': -s '$reads' #else: -f '$reads_fwd' -r '$reads_rev' $input_type.skip_pair_check #end if -o out.motus -g '$advanced_options.min_mgcs' -l '$advanced_options.minimum_alignment_len' #if $advanced_options.count_mode: -y '$advanced_options.count_mode' #end if #if $output_options.save_mgc: && mv out.motus.mgc '$output_mgc' #end if && mv out.motus '$output_motus'

param.name: sample_name
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Column header used for this sample in the report

param.name: skip_pair_check
param.label: Skip paired-read check
param.help: Do not verify that both read files contain the same read names. Useful if the mates are not sorted the same way or if one mate of a pair was removed.

param.name: db_source
param.label: mOTUs database source
param.option: Use a database from the history

validator.message: No compatible motus database is available

param.name: database_path
param.label: mOTUs database archive
param.help: The tar.gz archive of an mOTUs v4 marker gene database

param.name: save_mgc
param.label: Save the MGC abundance table
param.help: Additionally report the marker gene cluster (MGC) level abundances

param.name: count_mode
param.label: Read count type
param.help: How reads are counted and normalised

param.name: minimum_alignment_len
param.label: Minimum alignment length
param.help: Reads shorter than this length are discarded. Should be adjusted to the average read length of your data.

param.name: min_mgcs
param.label: Minimum number of marker gene clusters
param.help: An mOTU is only reported when this many of its marker gene clusters are covered. Lower values increase recall, higher values increase precision.

tool.help:
# Compute taxonomic profiles of metagenomic samples
mOTUs profiles the abundance of microbial taxa in metagenomic and metatranscriptomic samples. Reads are mapped against a database of species-level marker gene sequences, the abundance of each mOTU is quantified and reported together with its full taxonomic assignment.
This tool runs `motus profile`, which performs the `map_tax`, `calc_mgc` and `calc_motu` steps of the mOTUs pipeline in one go.
## Input
- Single-end or paired-end reads (FASTQ or FASTA, optionally gzipped) - An mOTUs v4 marker gene database
## Output
- **mOTUs profile**: tabular file with the mOTU identifier, its consensus taxonomy and the abundance of the sample - **MGC abundance table** (optional): marker gene cluster level abundances
## Parameters
- **Read count type**: how reads are counted. `insert scaled counts` (the default) normalises for marker gene length and scales the values so that they sum to the total number of inserted reads. - **Minimum number of marker gene clusters**: an mOTU is reported only if at least this many of its marker gene clusters are covered by reads. - **Minimum alignment length**: alignments shorter than this are ignored.
